text: ポケモンが　よわいのか　ぼくの　うでが　わるいのか…　どっちだと　おもう？

structure.jp: ポケモンが　よわいのか
structure.en: is it that my Pokémon are weak

structure.jp: ぼくの　うでが　わるいのか…
structure.en: or is it that my skill is poor...

structure.jp: どっちだと　おもう？
structure.en: which do you think it is?

patterns.name: 〜か〜か
patterns.span: よわいのか　ぼくの　うでが　わるいのか
patterns.explanation: Two possibilities each ending in のか are set side by side as 'is it this, or is it that'. よわいのか　わるいのか = 'whether they're weak or it's bad'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: どっちだと　おもう
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up the thought that is being thought. どっちだと　おもう = 'which do you think it is?'.
